user_reported_bug: en las cuentas empresa se pone la terminología pero sigue diciendo eventos puedes verificar? En cuentas con industria 'agency', varios labels seguían apareciendo como 'Eventos'. Iteración 248 arregló 30+ hits pero quedaron 3: PayablesSection.js:347 (tooltip 'Fuga de Margen'), PayablesSection.js:507 (warning 'Asigna a: Evento'), ReportsSection.js:577 (copy 'eventos').
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Verified the three reported agency terminology regressions end-to-end in the real UI: created demo agency termtest_agency_v5@kora.com, seeded an unassigned payable, logged in in Spanish, checked Payables warning card, Payables tooltip, and Reports P&L info card. All three now display Proyecto/Proyectos and the reported Evento/eventos copy did not appear. Cleanup deleted the demo agency account.
critical_code_review_comments: Code inspection confirmed PayablesSection.js lines 346-348 and 506-508, plus ReportsSection.js lines 576-578, now call term('events', 'entity_singular/plural') instead of hard-coded Evento/eventos.
seed_data_creation: Created demo agency termtest_agency_v5@kora.com with industry_type=agency and modules module_program_orchestration/module_demand_studio, then created one unassigned supplier payable to trigger margin leakage. Demo account was deleted via super-admin cleanup after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the preview origin https://foodops-insights.preview.emergentagent.com for UI automation because frontend .env points API calls to that same origin; localhost UI hits CORS due withCredentials. The successful test used the real public preview UI/API and cleaned up the demo account.
rca_of_the_issue: Regression was caused by hard-coded event terminology in PayablesSection and ReportsSection. Runtime verification showed the affected agency org resolves to industry_template=professional_services and renders the expected Spanish agency terms.
